Name: Giant backpack English
Author: Blossom5280
Description:
So while playing with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27613?tab=posts&jump_to_comment=144836040]Giant backpack[/url] mod i noticed that the text would blank out whenever i went to upgrade backpacks

Then i found while checking the content files i found it was in Japanese

The author gave me permission to make this translation!

i used google translate and translator on opera gx so it may not be the best!

[u] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ [b]﻿Installation Instructions[/b][/u][b]:[/b]
1. Download the content file.
2. Drop into the Giant backpack mod folder.
3. accept when it asks you to replace file.


let me know if there's any issues as this is my first mod/translation!

Original Mod belongs to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/xc333222/about-me?gameId=1303]xc333222
[/url]
